qa_pairs.question: How long does it take for my funds to be available to trade if I use wire transfer?

Funds deposited by

te: The cutoff time for wires is 5PM EST.

qa_pairs.question: Where do I check my deposit history?
qa_pairs.answer:
You may log into your TradeUP App and locate your transaction history under
Profile > TradeUP Account > Transfer History

qa_pairs.question: Why does it say my funds are not available to withdraw?
qa_pairs.answer:
There may be several possible reasons that you are not able to withdraw your funds:
You are withdrawing within 15 days of your deposit.
Per TradeUP Securities AML policies, clients may not initiate a withdrawal for funds within 15 days of the deposit.
The funds are not settled yet.
Funds will be available to withdraw after they are settled. The proceeds from your last sale transaction take 2 business days to settle. For option trades, the settlement period is 1 business day.
You are transferring out to a different account.
For AML purposes, if you are transferring out to a bank/brokerage account other than your originating bank account, there will be a 60-day withholding period.
Compliance Review
Certain withdrawal requests are subject to further compliance review and approval. Withdrawal activities without any trading activities or immediately after funding may be subject to enhanced due diligence questions or additional withholding period.
Recent Incoming ACATS
Funds/Securities deposited via ACATS cannot be withdrawn within 60 days through ACH or Wire.

qa_pairs.question: How do I withdraw my funds via wire transfer?
qa_pairs.answer:
Please navigate to
Profile > TradeUP Account > Withdraw > Wire Withdraw
on the TradeUP app and follow the wire withdrawal instructions. Wire transfers will be processed within 1 business day if everything is in good order. Please note, there is a $50/transaction fee for wire out activities.
TradeUP Securities, Inc. withdrawal fees do not cover third-party fees. The account holder will be solely responsible for any fees assessed by a beneficiary or correspondent bank. In addition, processing fees charged by your bank or its correspondent bank, which are not included in TradeUP Securities withdrawal fees, may be deducted from wire proceeds

qa_pairs.question: Why does it say my name on the bank does not match my account title?
qa_pairs.answer:
In order for Plaid to verify your bank information, the name on your bank account has to match exactly with the name on your TradeUP account.
For example, if your name on your bank account is Ana-Victoria Smith, and your name at TradeUP is Ana Victoria Smith, then Plaid will not be able to verify your bank information due to the mismatch.
You may request to update your name at TradeUP by submitting a copy of your valid photo ID to:
Please note: We can only change your name to match the exact information you have on your ID.
If your bank account name matches exactly with your TradeUP account, the error may be due to multiple account holders. If your bank account is a joint account, it may still be rejected for name mismatch even if your name is on the account.

qa_pairs.question: What is an ACH reversal?
qa_pairs.answer:
ACH reversal
is when the bank account reverses a deposit transfer.
This usually occurs due to insufficient account balance or having a non-transactional account at the delivering institution. Or an ACH Reversal could occur by an account holder’s request.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if my ACH is reversed?
qa_pairs.answer:
If your
ACH deposit is reversed
, there will be a
$30 fee
charged to your account for each ACH reversal. Meanwhile, our Compliance team will send you an email for more information regarding the reversal. Your funding and trading permissions may be temporarily restricted.
Please respond to the email and take required action accordingly to resume normal account functions. If there is a negative account balance generated due to the ACH reversal, the balance needs to be covered before trading permission can be granted.

qa_pairs.question: How long does it take to complete an ACATS transfer?
qa_pairs.answer:
Once the request is received, it typically takes
5-7 business days
for the assets to process, deliver, and settle in your TradeUP account.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any fees to transfer my assets via ACATS?
qa_pairs.answer: TradeUP does not charge any fees for incoming ACATS transfers. However, your delivering brokerage may charge a transfer fee.

qa_pairs.question: Is it possible to transfer in OTC market securities?
qa_pairs.answer:
Generally, OTC market securities are transferable. However, certain OTC market securities may not be supported by TradeUP.
Please click
to see which OTC stocks are accepted at TradeUP.

qa_pairs.question: Is it possible to transfer in Fractional Shares?
qa_pairs.answer: , fractional shares are non-transferable. When you initiate the transfer, the outside brokerage will most likely liquidate all the fractional shares in your account based on their fair market value. The proceeds should then be transferred to your TradeUP account as a residual transfer.

qa_pairs.question: Is it possible to transfer in a Margin Balance?
qa_pairs.answer: , margin balances are transferable. Before transferring in a margin balance, make sure your TradeUP account has been upgraded to a margin account to avoid potential account deficits.

qa_pairs.question: Are all types of options contracts eligible for transfer?
qa_pairs.answer:
, options contracts that expire within 7 days aren't transferable. You also can't use assets in your TradeUP account portfolio to serve as collateral for incoming options positions. Any collateral required for options must be part of the transfer.
Make sure your TradeUP account has been approved for the applicable level of options trading to ensure support of more advanced strategies.

qa_pairs.question: What if the outside brokerage account has non-transferable assets?
qa_pairs.answer: You can transfer eligible assets as a partial account transfer. For a full account transfer, you’ll need to liquidate the non-transferable assets to cash in the outside brokerage account before initiating the transfer.

qa_pairs.question: How can I view all my authorized ACH linkages through Plaid?
qa_pairs.answer:
To view your authorized ACH linkages through Plaid, you will have to sign up and access Plaid's portal
Once you've accessed Plaid's portal, you can not only view your authorized ACH linkages but can also choose to stop sharing or even delete the information directly from the portal.

qa_pairs.question: What happens when my ACH linkage expires after 12 months?
qa_pairs.answer:
After 12 months, your ACH linkage will expire and you will have to
relink the bank
account using Plaid. You can choose to link a new bank account, or choose the same one previously used.
Please follow these steps to link a bank account through Plaid:
Navigate to the
Portfolio
tab and click "Deposit".
Select "ACH Deposit" as the deposit method, then choose "Automatic Linkage".
Click "Get started!", then follow Plaid's instructions to link the bank account.

qa_pairs.question: Why do I need to reauthorize ACH linkage through Plaid?
qa_pairs.answer:
It is necessary to reauthorize ACH linkage due to
Section 1033 of the Dodd-Frank Act of 2010.
This rule formalizes consumer rights for financial data access and introduces new consumer protections to help ensure safe and secure data sharing.
Authorized third parties (such as TradeUP) are entities that are authorized by a consumer to receive their financial account information. Per
Section 1033
, consumers will need to reauthorize their account connections (such as ACH linkage through Plaid) to authorized third parties
every 12 months.
You can learn more about Section 1033
